title: Trump thanks Fifa after USA striker Balogun’s ban suspended
byline: Folarin Balogun is available to play for the United States in their World Cup last-16 tie against Belgium after his one-game ban was suspended by Fifa.

title: Norway knock out Brazil in shock win
byline: Erling Haaland scored twice in the closing stages as Norway stunned five-time champions Brazil 2-1 to reach the FIFA World Cup quarter-finals for the first time, sending one of the tournament favourites crashing out.

title: NTC launches islandwide inspections as revised bus fares take effect
byline: The National Transport Commission (NTC) has begun islandwide inspections today (06) to ensure strict compliance with the newly revised bus fare structure, which came into effect with increases ranging from 12% to 20%.

title: Last turbines delivered for Mannar wind farm
byline: The final batch of turbines required for the 50 MW HayWind wind power project in Mannar has arrived in Sri Lanka, marking a significant milestone in the country’s transition towards a sustainable energy future.

title: Kite flying near airports strictly prohibited
byline: Authorities have reminded the public that flying kites or any other airborne devices above 300 feet within a five-kilometer radius of Sri Lanka’s international airports is strictly prohibited due to the serious risks posed to aviation safety and public security.

title: Demolition of massive rock boulders on A5 road in Lunugala begins
byline: The demolition of what is considered the largest rock mass to have collapsed on a roadway in Sri Lanka hascommenced in the Lunugala 13 Kanuwa area (143 km post) along the Badulla–Chenkaladi A5 Road, officials said.

title: Eleventh national accident prevention week from today
byline: The Eleventh National Accident Prevention Week will commence today (6), aimed at raising public awareness on accident prevention across Sri Lanka.

title: Player dies after collapsing during cricket match in Beruwala
byline: A local cricket match in Beruwala ended in tragedy after a 46-year-old cricketer collapsed on the field and later died during a tournament organised by an old boys’ association of a school.

title: ’Now it’s over’ – Neymar announces Brazil retirement after World Cup exit
byline: Neymar has announced his retirement from international football following Brazil’s exit from the World Cup.

title: Sri Lanka’s next IMF decision must be about transformation, not another rescue
byline: Sri Lanka is once again approaching a consequential economic debate. As the present programme with the International Monetary Fund moves towards its concluding stages, the country will inevitably have to confront a difficult question: should Sri Lanka seek a further arrangement with the IMF?

title: TikTok love affair becomes an ordeal
byline: A 17-year-old youth has been arrested for sexually assaulting a 14-year-old girl whom he had made friends with through TikTok, the police said.

title: QR code fuel issuance system to continue; no change to quota
byline: The QR code-based fuel issuance system will continue without interruption, as the government has not taken any decision to discontinue the programme, Managing Director of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation (CPC), Mayura Neththikumara, said.

title: World Bank cautions Sri Lanka’s income upgrade remains fragile
byline: Sri Lanka’s return to upper-middle-income status has revived memories of an earlier promotion that proved short-lived, with the World Bank cautioning that the latest achievement remains vulnerable unless the country sustains reforms, strengthens growth and avoids the vulnerabilities that culminated in the 2022 economic crisis.

title: AWS to charge 18% VAT on unregistered Sri Lankan customers, but implementation date still pending
byline: Amazon Web Services (AWS) has notified its Sri Lankan customers that it will begin charging 18 percent Value Added Tax (VAT) on invoices for AWS cloud services and AWS Marketplace purchases, unless customers are VAT-registered and have submitted a valid Tax Registration Number (TRN) to the company.

title: Death toll climbs to 25 in deadly Negombo Prison violence
byline: The death toll from the violent unrest that erupted at Negombo Prison on Sunday (06) has risen to 25, according to police.

title: Negombo Prison violence claims 19 lives so far
byline: At least 19 people have so far died and more than 50 others have been injured in the violent unrest that erupted at the Negombo Prison, police said.

title: India orders Meta to remove ads promoting child sexual abuse
byline: The Indian government has directed Meta to immediately disable advertisements and content on Instagram that promote or facilitate child sexual abuse material, a senior official said.

title: Sri Lanka unveils 2026-2030 strategy to combat human trafficking
byline: Sri Lanka’s National Anti-Human Trafficking Task Force has outlined a new five-year strategy to combat human trafficking, highlighting the growing threat posed by technology-enabled recruitment, labour exploitation and organised transnational crime.

title: UPDATE - Death toll rises to 25, over 100 injured
byline: The death toll from the renewed unrest at the Negombo Prison has risen to 25, with more than 100 people injured, police said.

title: Police open fire to quell clash at Negombo Prison
byline: Police opened fire to bring a tense situation under control at the Negombo Prison today after clashes broke out between inmates and prison officers, leaving several officers injured.

title: Debate grows over dengue outbreak in Sri Lanka
byline: A growing public debate has emerged over the recent surge in dengue cases in Sri Lanka, amid conflicting views on whether a new viral strain is responsible for the outbreak.

title: Iran to close Tehran airspace for funeral ceremonies
byline: Iran will fully close Tehran’s airspace on Monday as part of funeral arrangements, the Iranian Students’ News Agency (ISNA) has reported.

title: Five children among 6 killed, in Mumbai chawl collapse
byline: Five children among six persons were killed in a house collapse in Mumbai’s Mankhurd area amid heavy rains on Sunday (July 5, 2026) night, officials said.

title: Fresh unrest erupts at Negombo Prison
byline: A fresh tense situation erupted at the Negombo Prison today, with several prison officers reportedly injured as authorities moved to bring the unrest under control.

title: Golden Boot War: Messi, Mbappé & Haaland locked on 7 as Kane closes in
byline: The race for the 2026 FIFA World Cup Golden Boot is heating up into a historic four-way battle, with football’s biggest names delivering under pressure on the global stage.

title: Impeachment trial of Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte begins
byline: The impeachment trial of Philippine Vice President Sara Duterte has begun in Manila, in a highly charged case that could determine her political future.

title: Inmates to be transferred following deadly Negombo Prison riot
byline: Authorities have begun arrangements to transfer a group of inmates from Negombo Prison to other prisons across the country following the deadly unrest at the facility.

title: China test fires missile into Pacific, alarming regional powers
byline: China’s military test-fired ​a missile from a nuclear-powered submarine into the Pacific on Monday, state media reported, drawing criticism and concerns ‌from Japan, Australia and New Zealand over Beijing’s expanding military reach.

title: Hirunika’s appeal against abduction conviction to be heard on August 6
byline: An appeal filed by former parliamentarian Hirunika Premachandra challenging her conviction and three-year prison sentence over a 2015 abduction case, has been fixed for argument before the Court of Appeal.

title: 2027 public and bank holidays gazetted
byline: The Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government Ministry has officially released the public and bank holiday schedule for the year 2027 through an Extraordinary Gazette notification.

title: Narahenpita railway station reopens after renovation
byline: The renovated Narahenpita Railway Station was officially reopened to the public this morning (6) under the government’s ‘Dream Destination’ initiative aimed at upgrading 100 railway stations across the country through a public-private partnership model.

title: Negombo prison clash: Inmates moved to Bogambara
byline: A group of inmates from Negombo Prison has been transferred to the Bogambara Open Air Prison in Pallekele, Kandy, following escalating violence inside the facility.

title: Three elephant corridors opened to address human-elephant conflict
byline: The government has cleared three major elephant corridors and established a special expert committee to formulate long-term solutions to Sri Lanka’s worsening human-elephant conflict, Deputy Minister of Environment Anton Jayakody announced today (6).

title: Clash erupted between two rival groups involved in underworld, drugs: Minister
byline: Claiming that the clash at the Nogombo prison had erupted between two rival groups involved in underwold activities and drugs, Minister of Justice and National Integration Harshana Nanayakkara said prision officilas had only intervened to resolve the clash.

title: SMB Finance PLC strengthens growth momentum following successful transformation
byline: SMB Finance PLC has reported a strong start to 2026, demonstrating significant improvements in profitability, stronger capitalization and enhanced asset quality as the company enters a new phase of sustainable growth following its transformation into a fully-fledged finance company.

title: Committee appointed to probe Negombo prison violence
byline: A committee has been appointed to investigate the violent incident that occurred at Negombo Prison, following approval granted at today’s (6) Cabinet meeting.

title: Early market gains fade as selling pressure dominates trading
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange ended today’s session in negative territory after failing to sustain a positive start. Both indices opened higher, reflecting early buying interest, but sentiment weakened as the session progressed, with profit-taking in several index-heavy counters eroding initial gains. Consequently, the ASPI declined by 98.08 points (-0.44%) to close at 22,080.65, while the S&P SL20 fell by 27.17 points (-0.44%) to 6,076.18.

title: No casualties among foreign inmates in Negombo prison clash: Authorities
byline: Prison authorities have confirmed that no foreign inmates sheltered at the Negombo Prison were injured or killed in the recent clashes.

title: Government launches immediate measures to tackle human-elephant conflict
byline: The government has launched a series of immediate measures to address Sri Lanka’s escalating human-elephant conflict, with efforts already underway to strengthen the operational capacity of the Department of Wildlife Conservation, Deputy Minister of Environment Anton Jayakody said.

title: Govt eyes dengue vaccine, Wolbachia method to combat rising cases
byline: The government is considering introducing a dengue vaccine and adopting the Wolbachia mosquito control method as part of efforts to address the growing dengue threat in Sri Lanka, Minister of Health and Mass Media Dr. Nalinda Jayatissa said today (6).

title: IRD opens e-service portal for 2025/2026 income tax returns
byline: The Inland Revenue Department (IRD) has announced that its e-service platform is now open for the filing of Income Tax Returns for the Year of Assessment 2025/2026.

title: Justice Minister takes responsibility over Negombo prison clash
byline: Minister of Justice and National Integration Harshana Nanayakkara said he will take the responsibility as the minister in charge of prions over the clash at the Negombo prison.

title: Actual dengue cases may exceed official count: GMOA
byline: The Government Medical Officers’ Association (GMOA) has raised concerns that the actual number of dengue infections in Sri Lanka could be significantly higher than the officially reported figures, warning that the country may be witnessing the early stages of a major outbreak similar to the 2017 epidemic.

title: Immigration deputy controller nabbed over alleged fake passport issuance
byline: The Deputy Controller (Administration) of the Department of Immigration and Emigration has been arrested for allegedly aiding and abetting the issuance of a fraudulent passport, police said.

title: UPDATE - Death toll rises to 26, over 100 injured
byline: The death toll from the renewed unrest at Negombo Prison has risen to 26. Nearly 100 individuals have reportedly sustained injuries in the clash.

title: Sri Lanka braces for El Niño impacts due to weather volatility warnings
byline: Sri Lanka is preparing for significant weather fluctuations in the coming months as a rapidly developing El Niño is expected to reduce rainfall and raise temperatures in the short term, while potentially bringing above-normal rainfall later in the year, officials said at a government media briefing held by the Department of Government Information.

title: Trump says 500,000 children receive first $1,000 Trump account deposits
byline: President Donald Trump said on Monday the government had deposited the first $1,000 into more than 500,000 ’’Trump Accounts,’’ a program ​designed to give newborn Americans a stake in the stock market and ‌help build wealth from an early age.

title: Inmates’ plan was to sabotage smooth functioning of prison operations: Minister
byline: The prison inmates have smashed the body scanner worth millions of rupees and CCTV systems in the Negombo prison, Minister of Justice and National Integration Harshana Nanayakkara said today.
